spells.name: Primal Blizzard
spells.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Astral Templars Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Hunter's Wings
spells.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 3 to the target's Move characteristic.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks that target the target unit.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Astral Templars Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
